REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF EDUCATION 
Texarkana Arkansas Schools 
May 19, 2026 
 
A regular meeting of the Board of Education of the Texarkana Arkansas School District No. 7 
was held May 19, 2026, at 6:01 p.m. at the Administration Building at 3435 Jefferson Avenue, 
Texarkana, Arkansas.  Board members present were Jesse Buchanan, Amy Leslie, Vickie Lacy, 
Paul Nix, Larry Manley, and Sandra Rhone. Holly Cunningham was absent. Others present were 
Superintendent Dr. Lloyd Jackson, Assistant Superintendent of Student Services Gwen Adams, 
Assistant Superintendent of Support Services Terry Taylor, Executive Director of School 
Leadership DeMarcus Green, Executive Director of Curriculum Instruction and Professional 
Development Lea Metcalf-McDonald, Business/HR Manager TyRhonda Henderson, Mallory 
Wyatt from the Texarkana Gazette and other interested patrons of the community. 
 
The meeting was opened with prayer by Amy Leslie followed by the Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
TASD special recognitions were as follows: Cory Robertson at Harmony Academy of Music and 
the Arts was recognized as the Care Employee of the Month.  
 
On recommendation of the administration, and on motion of Amy Leslie with a second by Paul 
Nix, the Board voted at 6:03 p.m. to approve the consent agenda items as follows: 
 
• Approval of minutes of the regular meeting of April 21, 2026. 
• Approval of the purchase of 1,823 chairs, 134 tables and 1,045 desks from Ledwell 
Offices to furnish classrooms at Fairview, Harmony, and Kilpatrick in the amount of 
$545,295.33 to be funded from the magnet grant.   
• Approval of the TIPS-USA quote for district awning repairs due to January 2026 
inclement weather from Texarkana Tent and Awning in the amount of $53,803.38 to be 
funded from the building fund and insurance claim payment. 
• Approval of removal of fixed assets from inventory list. 
• Approval of appointing Superintendent Dr. Lloyd Jackson to serve as representative for 
the SWAE Board of Directors. 
 
The Board heard the Superintendent’s Data Presentation – Preliminary Atlas Testing Data. 
 
Superintendent Dr. Jackson presented the April finance report. 
 
The Board heard the first reading of local policy change to policies 3.8 and 8.5. 
 
The Board reviewed the North Heights Pre-K MOU. 
 
The Board reviewed the Arkansas Rehabilitation Service MOU. 
 
The Board heard the first reading of the classified pay additions for 2026-2027. 
 
The Board reviewed the First Service transportation maintenance agreement.

May 19, 2026 
On recommendation of the administration and on motion of Larry Manley with a second from 
Sandra Rhone, the board voted at 6:35 p.m. to approve the Food Service Management Company 
proposal and contract from Chartwells for district-wide food service to begin July 1, 2026, for a 
period of one year, with the inclusion of four annual renewal periods.   
 
On recommendation of the administration and on motion of Amy Leslie with a second from 
Larry Manley, the board voted at 6:37 p.m. to approve grounds services proposal and contract 
from US Lawns for district-wide grounds services in the amount of $258,377.93 for be funded 
from the 2026-2027 operating budget to begin July 1, 2026, for a period of one year, with the 
inclusion of four annual renewal periods. 
 
On recommendation of the administration and on motion of Larry Manley with a second from 
Vickie Lacy, the board voted at 6:41 p.m. to approve the custodial services proposal and contract 
from SSC for district-wide custodial services in the amount of $1,697,356.08 to be funded from 
the 2026-2027 operating budget to begin July 1, 2026, for a period of one year, with the 
inclusion of four annual renewal periods 
 
On recommendation of administration and on motion of Larry Manley with a second from Amy 
Leslie, the board voted at 6:43 p.m. to approve the agreement with Magnet Schools of America 
to provide magnet school support services for Harmony, Kilpatrick, and Fairview in the amount 
of $155,700.00 to be funded from the magnet grant. 
 
At 6:44 p.m. the Board took a brief recess then entered into executive session for the purpose of 
discussing personnel. 
 
At 7:35 p.m. in open session, the following action was taken:  
 
On recommendation of the administration and on motion of Amy Leslie with a second by Larry 
Manley, the Board voted to approve the changes in personnel as presented. 
 
There being no further business to come before the Board, the meeting was adjourned at  
7:37 p.m.
